the soft agar assay for tumour stem cells is not an assay for single-cell tumour stem cells but for tumour cell aggregates.

the soft agar "assay" for human tumour cell growth is a test for the growth of aggregates of cells rather than a test for the ability of single cells to proliferate in the absence of anchorage to a substratum.
